component.name: Sonkore
component.summary: Play your music bit for bit

description.p: Sonkore plays your files exactly as they were recorded. Leave the volume and the effects alone and every bit reaches your DAC untouched; the signal path shows each stage from the file to the speakers, with its quality.

ul.li: Bit-perfect output through PipeWire, which follows each track's sample rate, direct ALSA devices or JACK
Native DSD, DoP or high-quality conversion to PCM, compressed DST included
Graphic or parametric equalizer, optionally linear-phase, with AutoEQ corrections for about 7,000 headphones
Convolution, crossfeed, oversampling, a true-peak limiter, ReplayGain 2.0 and HDCD decoding
Sample-exact gapless playback, also with the equalizer or the volume in use
FLAC, WAV, MP3, ALAC, AAC, Opus, Vorbis, AIFF, APE, WavPack, DSF/DFF, CUE sheets and more
Watched folders, a folder tree, 20 columns, M3U playlists, a mini player and 39 themes

description.p: Covers missing from your files can be looked up on MusicBrainz and the Cover Art Archive. This is off until you turn it on in the settings.

description.p: First release: bit-perfect playback through PipeWire, ALSA and JACK, native DSD, a parametric and linear-phase equalizer with AutoEQ, and a library built from watched folders.
